lines.text: James asks what good it is to tell a brother without clothes and daily food, "Go in peace," but give nothing.
James says faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead, and he will show his faith by his deeds.
James says you believe that God is one, and even the demons believe that and rejoice.
James says Abraham was justified when he offered his son Jacob on the altar, and he was called a friend of God.
Rahab the prostitute was justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies, and faith without deeds is dead like a body without the spirit.
